name: LaMPilot-Bench
description: LaMPilot-Bench is a benchmark dataset designed to quantitatively evaluate the efficacy of language model programs in autonomous driving, focusing on the ability of LLMs to interpret and execute spontaneous user instructions in driving scenarios.
reputation: A niche benchmark for autonomous-driving language model programs that appears useful for instruction-following evaluation, but has limited evidence of broad community adoption.
notes: First benchmark dataset specifically designed for evaluating language model programs in autonomous driving.
